title: The First Clue
musical: Rainbow Academy Musical - Magic School Adventure
description: Rainbow Academy Musical - Magic School Adventure | Plot: Major clue discovery, Act I climax revelation that the thief is still in the academy | Emotion: Triumph of discovery mixed with new urgency and danger | Setting: Hidden passages and secret areas of the academy at Evening, same day | Characters: Princess Luna, Princess Ruby, Princess Sage, Headmistress Aurora, All unicorn partners, Brief appearances by other students
lyrics:
RUBY:
Every passage that we're mapping

SAGE:
Every clue that we decode

RUBY:
Shows us how to catch the culprit

SAGE:
At the end of this dark road

BOTH:
We're not just students anymore
We're detectives on the case
And we won't stop searching
Till we see the villain's face

AURORA:
I wanted to protect you
Keep you safe from any harm
But I see now that your courage
Is your greatest charm

You're not children to be sheltered
You're young women, brave and true
And I'm proud to stand beside you
In whatever we go through

STARDUST:
In the starlight, I can see

BLAZE:
In the fire, I can feel

WHISPER:
In the memory, I know

ALL UNICORNS:
This mystery is real

But our magic's strong together
And our bond will see us through
When we follow where truth leads us
There's nothing we can't do
character_notes: The hidden passages behind Rainbow Academy's walls are revealed in full for the first time. Ancient stone corridors wind between the academy's rooms, lit by magical crystals that respond to the characters' presence.
